services.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Treasure Coast, our boarding facility stands unrivaled as the premier destination for horse enthusiasts. Spanning across an impressive 60 sprawling acres, our expansive property offers abundant space for your horses to thrive. Our commitment to equine well-being is evident in our largest grazing paddocks with run in sheds, where horses can roam freely and indulge in nourishing forage. We take pride in providing state-of-the-art amenities, including multiple sand, GGT, grass, and covered arenas, catering to riders of all disciplines and ensuring year-round training opportunities.
